items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My aunt Grace was really surrogate mother for many years.

ctx.x: Yeah, my father’s siblings. My aunt Grace was really surrogate mother for many years. She was great.
Yeah, I would have to imagine. If you essentially lost your mom when you were eight, that means your older brother was nine and then there were three others who were even younger than that, so…
